THE_FIRST_ANSWER_WAS_WRONG_AND_IS_WITHDR.what_is_actually_true: there is a canonical register. DEFECT_CLASS_REGISTER, apps/pipeline/services/palette_powder_protocol.py:1445, TWENTY-THREE classes, declared APPEND ONLY ('a correction is a new entry citing the old'), and bound into protocol_identity() as the 'defect_class_register' key of its payload — which is the strongest protection any artifact in this system has.
THE_FIRST_ANSWER_WAS_WRONG_AND_IS_WITHDR.why_the_search_missed_it: the register is keyed by NAME and this executor searched for NUMBERS. Every individual grep was correctly executed and every one of them was looking for the wrong shape. This is TWO_ROOTS_MEASUREMENT's lesson in a third costume: not a wrong path, not a narrow root, but a wrong KEY — and it returned the same clean, confident, false result. 'I found nothing' is not a finding until the shape of the search is stated with it.
THE_FIRST_ANSWER_WAS_WRONG_AND_IS_WITHDR.how_it_was_caught: by reading protocol_identity()'s payload while performing A391's compute step — 'defect_class_register' is one of its nine keys. The chain discipline caught the error, not suspicion. The false claim was on disk in this very record and had not yet been committed.

THE_ORDINALS_IN_THE_RECORDS_DO_NOT_MATCH.measured: palt_m6_matte_frames_stop.json cites 'thirteen_CAPTURE_WITHOUT_RETENTION', but CAPTURE_WITHOUT_RETENTION is the 21st entry of DEFECT_CLASS_REGISTER; that same record's own 'class_twenty_one' (a shadowed __post_init__) is GUARD_SHADOWED_BY_A_LATER_DEFINITION, the 14th. palt_m4c8's 'class_twenty' is MEASURE_CONFOUNDED_BY_A_PROCESS_VARIABLE, the 15th, and its 'sixteen' is MEASURE_INSENSITIVE_TO_ITS_SUBJECT, the 19th.
THE_ORDINALS_IN_THE_RECORDS_DO_NOT_MATCH.conclusion: two numbering schemes are in use and they disagree. The register carries no ordinal field; its numbers are positional only.
THE_ORDINALS_IN_THE_RECORDS_DO_NOT_MATCH.consequence_for_this_record: NO ORDINAL IS ASSIGNED ANYWHERE BELOW. Classes are cited BY NAME, which is unambiguous under both schemes. An earlier draft of this record called the proposed class 'class_twenty_three'; that number was doubly wrong — the register already holds 23 entries, and the ordinal would not have resolved under the records' own scheme.
THE_ORDINALS_IN_THE_RECORDS_DO_NOT_MATCH.this_is_itself_an_instance_of_DANGLING_A: a record citing a class by ordinal identifier that does not resolve to the same class in the canonical register. Recorded, not fixed: renumbering existing records is not this commit's act.

THE_REGISTER_IS_NOT_A_COMPLETE_CENSUS_OF.why_this_sits_inside_the_minting_questio: because it changes what a refusal to mint actually means. If the register were a complete census, 'the name is not in it' would be strong evidence the class is new. It is not a complete census, so that inference does not hold, and the owner should have the measurement before deciding.
THE_REGISTER_IS_NOT_A_COMPLETE_CENSUS_OF.the_measurement: TWO_ROOTS_MEASUREMENT — the class this arc cites more than any other, the one that has now fired THREE times in three different costumes and once inside this very record — HAS NO ENTRY IN DEFECT_CLASS_REGISTER. Membership tested directly, not recalled: 'TWO_ROOTS_MEASUREMENT' in DEFECT_CLASS_REGISTER is False, against 23 entries.
THE_REGISTER_IS_NOT_A_COMPLETE_CENSUS_OF.where_it_actually_lives: in prose, in four places, none of them a registration: progress_tracker.json at meta.color_governance_record_correction_2026_08_28 — ONE narrative field, 'the_class', inside a correction note about a different node; OWNER_BLOCKER_CLEARANCE.md (2 mentions); test_characterization_protocol.py (1, a comment, not an assertion); and palette_powder_protocol.py (1) — which is the REGISTER'S OWN HOST FILE, where the class is named in a comment roughly five hundred lines from the register that omits it.
THE_REGISTER_IS_NOT_A_COMPLETE_CENSUS_OF.which_corrects_a_scope_reading_made_one_: §BH4(k)(2), written at commit O, states that 'the one prior defect-class registration (TWO_ROOTS_MEASUREMENT) lives in progress_tracker.json under meta' and reasons from there that UNIT_MISMATCH should be registered alongside it to avoid a registry split across two locations. BOTH HALVES OF THAT ARE NOW MEASURED FALSE. That tracker field is a CITATION, not a registration — one string inside an unrelated correction note, with no definition, no first_instance, no commit and no date, which is what every real entry carries. And the registry is not split in two: there is exactly ONE registry, and this class was never entered in it. The reading is superseded here rather than deleted, per §AZ0(u).
THE_REGISTER_IS_NOT_A_COMPLETE_CENSUS_OF.what_this_is_an_instance_of: DANGLING_AUTHORITY_REFERENCE, in its strongest form yet found: not a citation resolving to the wrong entry, but a class name used as authority across four files, by both owner and executor, resolving to NO entry at all.
THE_REGISTER_IS_NOT_A_COMPLETE_CENSUS_OF.NOT_FIXED_HERE_AND_WHY: registering TWO_ROOTS_MEASUREMENT is minting, and minting is the exact act this section declines to perform unilaterally. Correcting §BH4(k)(2) in the register is a §BC act on the owner's own transcription, not a record write. Both are raised, neither is taken.
THE_REGISTER_IS_NOT_A_COMPLETE_CENSUS_OF.and_the_honest_reading_of_how_this_was_f: it was NOT found by an audit of the register. It was found while preparing the NEXT commit, by checking one citation this record makes — after the gate for this commit had already been started and was running green. The run was stopped and the record corrected. The parallel is exact and unflattering: a record whose subject is a false claim about the register was itself about to ship a false claim about the register, and no instrument in the sanctioned path reads either.
